gaps.description: Boundary condition ignorance: mountingType parameter in PcbStructuralDeflectionEngine is completely ignored; FOUR_CORNERS_SUPPORTED and FOUR_EDGES_CLAMPED produce identical outputs.
gaps.remediation: Implement discrete 2D Kirchhoff plate matrix solver supporting distinct edge and point support boundary conditions.

gaps.description: Physical formulation gap: Plate flexural rigidity D = E*h^3 / (12*(1-nu^2)) is omitted; 1D beam bending I = W*h^3/12 is used instead of 2D bi-harmonic plate equation.
gaps.remediation: Implement true 2D Kirchhoff plate flexural rigidity with Poisson's ratio coupling and bi-harmonic operator nabla^4 w = q/D.

gaps.description: Lack of discrete component load mapping: Components placed at (x,y) with non-zero mass are not mapped to spatial point loads on the substrate.
gaps.remediation: Integrate component placement mass mapping into nodal load vector {F} alongside distributed uniform pressure.

gaps.description: No stress tensor recovery: Engine only outputs a single scalar bending stress; no sigma_xx, sigma_yy, tau_xy, or von Mises stress field.
gaps.remediation: Compute spatial curvature tensor field from discrete displacement gradients and recover complete 2D surface stress tensor and von Mises stress.

gaps.description: No numerical solver diagnostics: No matrix condition check, no singularity rejection for unconstrained plates, no algebraic residual norm ||Kw - F||.
gaps.remediation: Implement Gaussian elimination / Cholesky factorization with pivot check, singular matrix error diagnostics, and algebraic residual tracking.

gaps.description: No static equilibrium / reaction verification: Engine does not verify that total reaction forces balance total applied vertical loads.
gaps.remediation: Calculate reaction forces at constrained support points and enforce |sum(R_z) - F_total| / F_total < 1e-4.

gaps.description: No mesh refinement convergence verification: No mechanism to evaluate error reduction across finer spatial grids.
gaps.remediation: Implement grid refinement test suite evaluating monotonic convergence on analytical benchmark plates (Navier and Timoshenko solutions).
